0022600202.text: The Kings (1-8, 0-4 at home, on a two-game losing streak) host the Heat (3-6, 1-3 at home) in Sacramento's 10th game of the season, with Sacramento 15th in the West and 6.5 games back in the Pacific, while Miami is 9th in the East and 2.5 games back in the Southeast. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (out following Achilles surgery), Keegan Murray (out with an ankle injury), and Maxime Raynaud (out with a dislocated knee), while Miami has no players listed as unavailable. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet this season, and the Kings lost the last meeting 130-117 in Sacramento on January 20, 2026.
